description: Import products from an arbitrary CSV/TSV export (from any platform not covered by import_product_feed) by pasting raw delimited text. Column mapping is optional — when omitted, headers are auto-matched by common name patterns (title/name, sku/product id, price, description, category, qty/stock, image, vendor/brand, tags). Products save as drafts by default for review. For .xlsx files, convert to CSV first (spreadsheet apps support "Save as CSV" / "Export").

csvText.description: Raw CSV or TSV text: header row followed by data rows

importAs.description: Import visibility. Use draft for review workflows; active only when the user clearly wants products published immediately.

mapping.description: Explicit column mapping. Omit to auto-detect from header names.

imageUrl.description: header name for the primary image URL

title.description: header name for the product title (required)

replaceDemoProducts.description: Delete template demo/sample products before importing. Default false.

name: import_product_spreadsheet
